messages.subject: Forecat, fitted and smoothed
parts:
Hello, 

Still working on time series ...

Let's consider D_t, the set of information available at time t. Let Y_t be a random variable, t=1, ..., T. In the Kalman filter framework, the following distributions are defined:
Y_t|D_{t-1} as forecast value
Y_t|D_t as fitted value
Y_t|D_T as smoothed value

I wonder what the INLA fitted values are ? I assume they are smoothed values. Am I right ?
Thanks in advance.

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Forecat, fitted and smoothed
parts:
Yes, it’s the estimate of the predictor expression given the whole data.
Finn
